epic: E16 — UI-binding: triggers / entry-points / step-outcomes / links
scenario: CRM/столп2 equivalent seeded scenario: create «Заявка» (purchases) → on_create starts telLinear «Согласование» → approve → step-outcome entity + record↔process links
method: REAL BROWSER (Playwright headless chromium, seeded chs-kc-session, ROPC fixtures). Full local stack: fresh Keycloak (:8480) + fresh throwaway DB choros_lp (:55432) + Flowable 7.1.0 (:8482) + choros server keycloak-mode (:3090) + web SPA.

journey_steps.step: 1. Create a record starts a process (create = start, on_create)
journey_steps.ui_path: login e-orlov → /app-records/<tel-approval> → select набор полей «Заявки» → «Создать запись» drawer → fill Тема/Сумма/Инициатор → submit
journey_steps.evidence: POST /api/records → 201 (record a79e2602). Record card /apps/<app>/records/<rec> «ПРОЦЕССЫ ПО ЭТОЙ ЗАПИСИ» shows the started «Канонический линейный ТЭЛ» (telLinear) with status ОЖИДАНИЕ. Flowable confirms a telLinear instance (a68df920) started on record create. Screenshots A1-A4. ZERO bypass.

journey_steps.step: 2. Action on the object (approve the bound step from the UI)
journey_steps.ui_path: login e-larina → /inbox (tab «Все»/«Из пула») → row «Согласование» / process «Канонический линейный ТЭЛ» → «Взять» (claim pool task) → «Согласовать»
journey_steps.evidence: POST /api/inbox/<id>/claim → 200; POST /api/inbox/<id>/action {action:approve} → 200 body {status:done, outcome:approve, engine:completed}. Screenshots B1-B3. The approve action ITSELF was zero-bypass. CAVEAT: reaching this approvable state required the P0 triage bypass below — the instance parked at «Триаж» after create and would never surface «Согласование» without it.

Process card shows ЗАВЕРШЕНО, «Текущий шаг: Завершено», «Прогресс 1/1», full «История переходов» (Начало→Подача заявки→Триаж→Согласование→«Нужно доп. согласование?» gateway→end) with node types. Step-outcome ENTITY confirmed in DB: a «Согласование» record (a319a149) was created by the step-applier carrying purchase_ref=a79e2602 (the source заявка) and outcome=approve. Screenshot B5. ZERO bypass (browser).

journey_steps.step: 4. Links work (record↔process resolve to human names, navigate, no raw UUID)
journey_steps.ui_path: record card «ПРОЦЕССЫ ПО ЭТОЙ ЗАПИСИ» (e-orlov) + process card «ЗАПИСЬ-ИСТОЧНИК» (e-larina)
journey_steps.evidence: PARTIAL: (a) record→process reverse link resolves to human name «Канонический линейный ТЭЛ» for the CREATOR e-orlov, no UUID (A4). (b) КЕМ ЗАПУЩЕН on the process card resolves to «К. Орлов» (B5). BUT forward link FAILS: process card «ЗАПИСЬ-ИСТОЧНИК» renders a RAW UUID `a79e2602-65d6-4098-bcaf-26fc3a77a7c0` (not the record's human title «LP T-0691 браузер-заявка»), AND GET /api/records/<заявка> returns 404 for the acting approver e-larina (200 for e-orlov) → the record-source link is unnavigable for the actor who just acted on the process. Screenshot B5.

bypasses.what: Complete the «Триаж» agent external-task (topic=tel-intake) to advance the create=start instance from «Триаж» to the human-approvable «Согласование» step.
bypasses.why: The seeded telLinear triage step (serviceTask, flowable:type=external, topic=tel-intake) has NO runtime completer in the running/deployed stack. The lifecycle bridge fetch-and-locks it into choros.job (state=CREATED), but the agent-dispatch loop only processes AGENT_TOPICS=agent-step (explicitly NOT tel-intake, per T-0460 ADR), and there is no separate triage/smoke worker service. So the instance parks at «Триаж» forever and «Согласование» never appears in any inbox. Only the TEST harness bridge-smoke-runner produces the tel-intake task_completed.
bypasses.had_to_do: Inserted the missing `task_completed` outbox row (aggregate_kind=job, idempotency_key=complete:<jobId>, state=pending) that the absent worker should produce — exactly the shape bridge-smoke-runner.ts uses — then let the RUNNING server's own deliver loop completeTask in Flowable (running evaluateGatewayAtTriage → approvalRequired injected). Done once per instance (HTTP smoke + browser instance).

p0_findings.what: P0 — Create=start process PARKS at the «Триаж» agent step and never reaches the human step. The seeded telLinear triage (topic=tel-intake) has no runtime completer: bridge fetches it into choros.job (CREATED) but nothing produces its task_completed. AGENT_TOPICS=agent-step (dispatcher) excludes tel-intake; no triage worker service in docker-compose.yml. Likely root cause: the canonical telLinear BPMN's agent serviceTask uses the LEGACY topic `tel-intake` while the current agent-dispatch runtime (T-0460) only drives topic `agent-step` (AGENT_STEP_TOPIC). Net effect on столп 2: a user creating a record starts a process that silently stalls before any человек can act — 'green in CI, dead live'.
p0_findings.expected_ui: After create=start, the process should auto-advance through the DORMANT/deterministic «Триаж» agent step and present «Согласование» in the approver's inbox with no operator intervention.
p0_findings.had_to_do: Injected the tel-intake completion (see bypass). Without it the journey cannot progress past step 1.

p0_findings.what: P1 — record↔process link broken for the ACTING user. On the process card «ЗАПИСЬ-ИСТОЧНИК» shows the source record as a RAW UUID (no human title) and GET /api/records/<заявка> returns 404 for the approver e-larina (200 for the creator e-orlov). So the actor who just approved the process cannot open the source record from the process card — the link both leaks a UUID and dead-ends in 404 (likely PDP/read-grant masking: the approver has no read grant on the initiator's заявка record).
p0_findings.expected_ui: «ЗАПИСЬ-ИСТОЧНИК» should render the record's human title and navigate to a readable record card for any user entitled to act on the process (столп 2/§6: read-through projection with per-hop ACL, not a hard 404).
p0_findings.had_to_do: Observed only; recorded. e-orlov can navigate; e-larina cannot.

minor_findings: P2 — coarse current-step projection: right after create the record card + inbox-less state shows «Текущий шаг: Подача заявки / ОЖИДАНИЕ», but the instance is actually past «Подача заявки» (auto-completed via skip-submit) parked at the «Триаж» serviceTask. Same class as T-0709/T-0718 stale-projection.

P3 — record card «ПРОЦЕССЫ ПО ЭТОЙ ЗАПИСИ» shows the raw process key `telLinear` next to the human name «Канонический линейный ТЭЛ» (T-0717 class — human name present, so acceptable, but the bare key is shown).
record detail header/breadcrumb shows the record's own id as a raw UUID (a79e2602-…) — common record-detail header pattern.
overall_rationale: 3 of 4 journey steps passed IN-BROWSER (create=start, approve, step-outcomes visible incl. the step-outcome entity + cross-ref pointer). BUT the epic is NOT proven zero-bypass: step 2/3 were only reachable via a P0 bypass (no runtime completer for the triage agent step → process stalls before any human can act), and step 4 (links) FAILS for the acting user (process→record link is a raw UUID + 404). Two blocking product gaps.
